content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define what is meant by a balanced diet
Explain how dietary needs vary with age, activity, and health
Describe the consequences of an unbalanced diet
Understand the concept of energy balance

contains all the nutrients in the correct proportions to meet the body's needs. The exact requirements vary between individuals depending on factors like age, activity level, and health status. An unbalanced diet can lead to malnutrition, obesity, or deficiency diseases.
